# Hi, I'm Eugeni!

::: {.lead}
I’m a mobility researcher with a background in environmental management, transport planning and data analytics — oh, and I studied law too. I'm passionate about cycling, maps and data visualisation. My research looks at how changes to the built environment affect the way people move, how those changes are received, and who benefits from them.

I'm currently based at [GEMOTT](https://gemott-uab.cat/en/) (*Research Group on Mobility, Transport and Territory*), within the [Department of Geography](https://www.uab.cat/en/geography) at the [Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona](https://www.uab.cat/).

This website brings together my research, publications, and materials. Feel free to explore, or <a href="mailto:eugenividal@hotmail.com">get in touch</a>. ✉️
:::
